ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobe regions and 60% low-intensity black pixels along the periphery and within mottled zones.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, irregular white geometric blobs are located in the center of the left and right lobes. The left lobe blob is surrounded by heavy low-intensity mottling along the inferior edge. The right lobe blob contains dense, high-frequency black speckling on its medial (inner) boundary. The lateral tips and trailing edges consist of solid low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 120 degrees; the precise vertex point is partially obscured by water spray and motion blur.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely jagged trailing edge characterized by high-amplitude, irregular serrations. Visible peaks extend 5-10 pixels beyond the median edge line, interspersed with sharp valleys, particularly prominent on the superior margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature across the superior trailing edges, terminating in acute, sharp-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Group of 4-6 high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (approximately 3-5 pixels in diameter) localized on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of distinct, unaligned high-intensity linear pixel strings (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally and cutting across the primary white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular excision or deep notch on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe; multiple parallel linear rake marks present on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'salt-and-pepper' mottling effect where high-intensity and low-intensity pixels are intermixed at the boundaries of the central white patches.
